topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe it—Jake, my online friend for years, lives just a few blocks away. We've shared so much, big dreams and tiny details, and I never even considered that we might be neighbors. Now, every time I'm out, I find myself looking around, feeling like I should have known, should have guessed. I think about all the times we've talked about meeting up someday, and here we are, suddenly it's possible, but I'm not sure how to bring it up. I want to surprise him, but what if it feels creepy instead? Maybe I should just send a message, play it cool, see how he reacts. It’s a small world, isn’t it?
